sessionStart.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for d in "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}"/installed-plugins/*/tsk "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}"/installed-plugins/_direct/*tsk*; do if [ -f "$d/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; then r="$d"; break; fi; done; fi; exec bash "$r/hooks/session-start.sh" --format copilot

agentStop.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for d in "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}"/installed-plugins/*/tsk "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}"/installed-plugins/_direct/*tsk*; do if [ -f "$d/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; then r="$d"; break; fi; done; fi; exec bash "$r/hooks/stop.sh"

sessionEnd.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for d in "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}"/installed-plugins/*/tsk "${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}"/installed-plugins/_direct/*tsk*; do if [ -f "$d/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; then r="$d"; break; fi; done; fi; exec bash "$r/hooks/session-end.sh"
